contents_summary: ZIP with one 9-page PDF Supplementary Material for the index patient EEG analysis: a methods paragraph on the single threshold permutation test (page 1); t-value histograms with printed critical-t labels for the PSD (Figure S1), connectivity (Figure S2) and Lempel-Ziv complexity (Figure S6) comparisons; chart-only graph-metric curves against connection density for delta, theta and alpha (Figures S3 to S5); and Tables S1 to S3 of graph-metric statistics (|t0.05|, t-value, p-value, pFDR) per band.

pages.contents: Page 1: heading Supplementary Material and section A, Statistical non-Parametric Mapping (SnPM), single threshold test for the maximum t-statistic: one paragraph explaining the permutation procedure with a worked example.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Methods rationale for the permutation test; its worked-example numbers (30 and 32 epochs, 183 electrodes, 5000 relabelings) restate analysis parameters already given in the main text, so no clinical data are typed from this page.
limitations: No page-level rights notice or exception is printed on this page.

pages.contents: Page 2: section B, PSD analysis; Figure S1 with three histograms (delta, theta, alpha) of electrode-wise t-values with red vertical lines and printed threshold labels, and the Figure S1 caption.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Printed t-threshold labels (t0.05) for the PSD comparison of the index patient are typed; histogram bar heights are not transcribed.
limitations: The threshold labels are printed inside the figure image with the 0.05 as a subscript; transcribed as t0.05.

pages.contents: Page 3: section C, Connectivity analysis; Figure S2 with three histograms (delta, theta, alpha) of electrode-couple t-values with red vertical lines and printed threshold labels, and the Figure S2 caption.
pages.clinical_relevance_notes: Printed t-threshold labels (t0.05) for the connectivity comparison of the index patient are typed; histogram bar heights are not transcribed.
limitations: The threshold labels are printed inside the figure image with the 0.05 as a subscript; transcribed as t0.05.
The theta labels differ from the value stated in the main Figure 3 caption; not reconciled.

pages.contents: Page 4: section D, Graph theoretical metrics; Figure S3 (delta) with five line charts against connection density and its caption. Chart-only page: line charts of five graph metrics (strength, local efficiency, global efficiency, modularity, participation coefficient) against connection density 0.9 to 0.1 with orange and blue lines for the hallucinations and resting-state conditions and error bars (mean plus or minus standard error). No numeric readings are printed, so nothing is typed as clinical data; the corresponding statistics are in Tables S1 to S3 on pages 7 and 8.

transcriptions.text: Figure S1. Statistics of the PSD analysis.
In each plot the t-thresholds for significance at p < 0.05 (estimated using a single threshold permutation test for the maximum t-statistics, 5000 permutations), are denoted by red lines.
Figure S2. Statistics of the connectivity analysis.
In each plot the t-thresholds for significance at p < 0.05 (estimated using a single threshold permutation test for the maximum t-statistics, 5000 permutations), are denoted by red lines.
Figure S6. Statistics of the Lempel-Ziv Complexity.
In each plot the t-thresholds for significance at p < 0.05 (estimated using a single threshold permutation test for the maximum t-statistics, 5000 permutations), are denoted by red lines.
Table S1. Delta networks. Statistics of between-condition comparisons (visual hallucinations versus resting-state) are reported for graph each metric.
Table S2. Theta networks. Statistics of between-condition comparisons (visual hallucinations versus resting-state) are reported for graph each metric.
Table S3. Alpha networks. Statistics of between-condition comparisons (visual hallucinations versus resting-state) are reported for graph each metric.
